items.text: Most "best paying jobs for humanities students" lists rank by a single flashy number, often a rare top-end salary that almost no one entering the field actually earns in year one.

items.heading: Searches for "Arts Career Options
items.text: Searches for "arts career options with salary" and "humanities jobs list and salary" usually mean one thing: I studied English, history, political science or sociology, so which of these lanes can I actually enter, and what do I add on top? The table below reads the ranking above by degree subject. It adds no new pay figures, so every number stays where its source is stated.
